claims.label: false
claims.locator: Hoax claims and rebuttals / Photographic and film oddities, item 4

variants.en: The lack of stars in short-exposure lunar photographs proves the photographs were staged.
variants.zh: 短曝光月面照片中没有恒星，这证明照片是摆拍的。

variants.en: Any authentic photograph from the Moon must show stars behind a sunlit astronaut.
variants.zh: 任何真实的月球照片都必须在受阳光照射的宇航员背后显示恒星。

correction.en: Exposures set for bright sunlit subjects usually do not record faint stars.
correction.zh: 针对明亮阳光下物体设置的曝光通常无法记录暗弱的恒星。

claims.label: false
claims.locator: Hoax claims and rebuttals / Environment, item 5

variants.en: The rippled lunar flag proves that wind was blowing on a studio set.
variants.zh: 月球旗帜的波纹证明摄影棚里有风在吹。

variants.en: A flag can only move when air blows across it, even when someone twists its pole.
variants.zh: 即使有人扭动旗杆，旗帜也只有在空气吹过时才能运动。

correction.en: Handling moves the flag; a support bar and storage folds explain its extended, rippled shape.
correction.zh: 人的操作会使旗帜运动；支撑杆和折痕解释了展开且有波纹的形状。

claims.label: false
claims.locator: Hoax claims and rebuttals / Photographic and film oddities, item 5

variants.en: Different apparent shadow angles in a lunar photograph prove multiple studio lamps were used.
variants.zh: 月面照片中不同的表观影子角度证明使用了多盏摄影棚灯。

variants.en: Under sunlight, all shadows must look parallel in every photograph regardless of terrain.
variants.zh: 在阳光下，无论地形如何，所有影子在任何照片中都必须看起来平行。

correction.en: Perspective and uneven terrain can make shadows from sunlight appear nonparallel in an image.
correction.zh: 透视和不平坦地形会使阳光产生的影子在图像中显得不平行。

claims.label: false
claims.locator: Hoax claims and rebuttals / Photographic and film oddities, item 1

variants.en: A washed-out crosshair on a bright object proves the lunar photograph is a composite.
variants.zh: 明亮物体上消失的十字线证明月面照片是合成的。

variants.en: Camera crosshairs can disappear only when someone pastes objects over a photograph.
variants.zh: 相机十字线只有在有人将物体粘贴到照片上时才会消失。

correction.en: Overexposure and reproduction can wash out thin dark crosshairs in bright regions.
correction.zh: 过度曝光和复制会使明亮区域的细暗十字线消失。

claims.label: false
claims.locator: Hoax claims and rebuttals / Environment, item 6

variants.en: A sharp footprint cannot form in lunar dust unless liquid water is added.
variants.zh: 除非加入液态水，否则月壤中不可能形成清晰脚印。

variants.en: Well-defined lunar boot prints prove that wet studio sand was used.
variants.zh: 清晰的月面靴印证明使用了摄影棚的湿沙。

correction.en: Angular lunar dust grains can retain footprint shapes without liquid water.
correction.zh: 有棱角的月壤颗粒无需液态水也能保留脚印形状。

claims.label: false
claims.locator: Hoax claims and rebuttals / Photographic and film oddities, item 6

variants.en: Similar distant mountains in different lunar photographs prove a painted backdrop was reused.
variants.zh: 不同月面照片中相似的远山证明重复使用了绘制的背景幕。

variants.en: A lunar mountain must look completely different after a short walk, so similar views are fake.
variants.zh: 短途步行后月球山脉必须看起来完全不同，因此相似景色是假的。

correction.en: Distant mountains change little in apparent position over short walks; the Moon has little atmospheric haze.
correction.zh: 短途步行中远山的表观位置变化很小；月球几乎没有大气薄雾。
